task_description: Implement undo/redo system for all operations except export. Export should be cancellable.

files_to_reference.pattern: Immutable model with const constructor, copyWith, equality operators
Immutable model with List field handling

patterns.state_notifier: All providers use StateNotifier<T> with immutable state updates via state = newState
patterns.immutable_updates: Always create new List/Map instances, use copyWith for partial model updates
patterns.binary_data_separation: Image bytes stored in ImageCacheService, only metadata in provider state
patterns.cross_provider_mutation: Use ref.read(otherProvider.notifier).method() for cross-provider state changes
patterns.widget_pattern: ConsumerStatefulWidget with ref.watch() for reactive, ref.read() for mutations

state_management.description: Riverpod StateNotifier pattern throughout. All state is immutable.

image_cache.description: ImageCacheService stores binary image bytes separately from metadata
image_cache.note: Critical: undo/redo should NOT store bytes in history, only metadata

cross_cutting_operation.description: createGroupFromSelection() modifies both GroupsNotifier and ImagesProvider state
cross_cutting_operation.note: Undo must restore both states atomically

export.description: ExportController.exportAll() is async Future with no cancellation mechanism

critical_constraints.memory: Do NOT store Uint8List bytes in undo history - will cause memory explosion
critical_constraints.atomicity: Cross-provider operations must be undone atomically (groups + images together)
critical_constraints.export_exclusion: Export operations must NOT be added to undo history
critical_constraints.history_limit: Limit undo history to 50 states to prevent memory issues
